notes.title: Prologue Patch #01
notes.notes:
Hey, everybody!

First off, we want to say thank you for playing the Prologue and giving it a Very Positive rating in just five days. We're so happy you can finally get your hands on it, and we can't wait to share the full game with you as well.

As you may imagine, putting the Prologue out brought a few technical issues to our attention. We of course tested it thoroughly, but the sheer number of players and different hardware setups that have run Lacuna over the past few days is unprecedented. We also added little extra bits of polish here and there. (:

We hope the update ensures an even smoother experience. If you still encounter one of the issues below or a different bug, please let us know here in the forum or send us an e-mail: support[at]digitales.games

Best,
Julian

Patch notes

General improvements


 Outline Mode no longer spawns "shadow NPCs" during phone calls
 Outlines no longer appear on people or objects that cannot be interacted with
 Fixed an issue where avatar would get stuck walking into a wall at low FPS
 Fixed an issue where controller wouldn't stop rumbling after screen shake ended


UI improvements


 Fixed an issue where HUD icons would disappear after a cutscene
 HUD icons are now hidden during ending trailer
 Fixed an issue where opening and quickly closing Cell would cause buttons to vanish
 Increased some UI element sizes to accommodate Japanese text size
 Added lots of UI sounds (see audio improvements below)
 Various small text & layout improvements


Level improvements


 Added light sources to Villa balcony floodlights
 Improved Villa floor colliders to avoid getting stuck at terrace entrance
 Player now gets feedback at the end of Villa in any case (not only in case of incorrect solution)


Audio improvements


 Fixed a bug where Investigation Mode would turn up music volume
 Increased loudness consistency and overall loudness of Chinese voice-over
 Fixed an issue where parallel music layers weren't perfectly synchronized
 Added sound effects to pause menu UI
 Added sound effects to commercial billboards
 Added sound effects to HUD icons
 Added some scene-specific sound effects
 Improved ambience sound ranges & placement
 Improved CigOMat & NewsOMat sound ranges & placement
 Credits scene no longer plays ambience sound
